findings.title: SQL Injection in GraphQL jobs(jobType) Parameter — CTF Flag Extracted
findings.description: The GraphQL `jobs` query accepts a `jobType` String argument that is passed unsanitized into a SQL query. By injecting `' OR '1'='1`, all rows are returned including a hidden record containing the CTF flag.
